vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.7

The tickerdb skill is a legitimate market intelligence tool for querying stock, crypto, and ETF data from api.tickerdb.com. It includes a well-defined onboarding flow for authentication, standard financial data endpoints (summary, search, watchlist), and automation features via OpenClaw's cron system. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found; the behavior is entirely consistent with its stated purpose as a financial data integration.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose of querying the TickerDB API and only request the single API key needed to operate.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the declared requirements: the skill calls TickerDB API endpoints and only asks for TICKERDB_KEY as the primary credential. No unrelated cloud credentials, system binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs the agent to perform an onboarding flow that asks the user for an email, POSTs to TickerDB auth endpoints, accepts a 6-digit code, and shows/saves the returned apiKey. This is coherent with creating or retrieving an API key, but it does require collecting the user's email and auth code and (with user consent) persisting the API key — so treat these as expected but privacy-sensitive operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is downloaded or written by an installer, which minimizes filesystem/remote code risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single environment variable (TICKERDB_KEY) is required as the primary credential. That is proportional to the skill's stated function of making authenticated calls to api.tickerdb.com.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and user-invocable:true. The skill does instruct saving the API key if the user confirms, which relies on platform credential persistence; this is reasonable but depends on trusting the platform's storage behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill behaves as a thin API client for TickerDB and will ask you to sign in with an email and a 6-digit verification code to obtain an API key. If you proceed: (1) only provide the email and verification code if you trust TickerDB and this agent; (2) prefer creating a limited-scope API key on TickerDB (if the service supports it) and revoke it if you stop using the skill; (3) when asked whether to save the key, understand that persisting the key allows the agent to make calls on your behalf — decline if you prefer to enter the key each session; (4) review TickerDB's privacy/security docs if you care about how your email or usage data is handled; and (5) if you want to limit automated activity, avoid enabling autonomous agent behavior or avoid saving the key so the skill cannot run without explicit approval.
